title: Summer 1 review set: angles and area (10 questions)
subject: Mathematics
source: Written for mathematics/y8 lesson 69 (Practise your target from the quiz: the portal's Summer 1 review set (10 questions).)
intro: Lesson 69 homework. Do the questions on your target topic first, then the rest. Show working and give reasons for angles.

questions.q: Find the angle alternate to 64°. Give a reason.
Two co-interior angles: one is 118°. Find the other.
Find the sum of the interior angles of an octagon.
Find one interior angle of a regular 9-sided polygon.
A regular polygon has an exterior angle of 24°. How many sides does it have?
Find the area of a triangle with base 9 cm and perpendicular height 6 cm.
Find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides 6 cm and 10 cm and height 5 cm.
Find the area of a circle with radius 7 cm (1 d.p.).
Find the circumference of a circle with diameter 12 cm (1 d.p.).
Give the order of rotational symmetry and the number of lines of symmetry of a regular hexagon.
